description: Expose the HTTP status of createServiceDomain and createWorkspaceDomainOwnership as `httpStatus`. Both creates are idempotent: the spec documents 201 when the call created the resource and 200 when it already existed (`POST /v1/services/{serviceId}/domains`: 200 "Custom domain already registered on this service"; `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/domain-ownerships`: 200 "The workspace already holds a domain ownership for the domain"). The body is the same in both cases, so only the status tells a caller whether it owns what came back. alchemy-run/alchemy's Prisma.CustomDomain refused a 200 before it moved to distilled.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: 201 when the call created it, 200 when it already existed.
201 when the call created it, 200 when it already existed.
